Ferry timetable changes announced for the islands

By A. Reporter, 4 March

Tourism operators welcomed the change, noting that late afternoon departures would let day trippers stay for dinner instead of rushing back to the mainland. The first sailings under the new schedule will be free for children, pensioners and anyone carrying a valid island residency card, the authority confirmed. Critics argued that the plan favoured visitors over people who live on the islands all year, and asked for earlier crossings on weekdays so that workers and students could travel without a long wait.
